title: 4-Hour Tunnel Sync: LWW Overwrite vs CRDT + Outbox Convergence
description: Step through how an offline edit on a train collides with a teammate's online commit across IndexedDB, Web Locks, and idempotent sync.

steps.label: 1. Offline Write Hits IndexedDB Quota & Transaction
steps.description: Client A enters a tunnel and edits section 2. The write commits to IndexedDB inside an explicit readwrite transaction.

steps.label: 2. Teammate Commits Concurrent Edit Online
steps.description: While Client A is disconnected, Client B edits section 1 and pushes v43 to the server. Without CRDTs, Client A's stale snapshot will clobber v43.

steps.label: 3. Multi-Tab Wakeup Contends on Storage
steps.description: Client A exits the tunnel with two open tabs. BroadcastChannel notifies peers while navigator.locks serializes outbox drainage so tabs do not race.

steps.label: 4. Idempotent Outbox Flushes CRDT Delta
steps.description: The leader tab sends the encoded Yjs delta with an idempotencyKey. A retry on flaky cellular 4G deduplicates cleanly on the server.
steps.codeHighlight: fetch('/sync', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': op.id }, body: delta });
